title: Chapter 1176
text:
Boom!

It was as if thousands of thunderbolts had exploded out of nowhere. The violent Mechanical Force lightning was like a dancing silver dragon, dazzling and eye-catching.

The people of Planet Earth Ring looked up. It was as if two new suns surrounded by lightning suddenly appeared in the sky.

Two light gates suddenly opened in space, and countless mechanical troops swarmed out of their secondary dimensional army boxes. The scene was like a dam breaking.

On one side, it was dark like a black cloud, and on the other side, it was white like a snowy mountain had collapsed.

The mechanical army, one black and one white, surrounded the two of them like a flock of crows. They were covered by the large net weaved by the Mechanical Force lightning chains and pulled toward the center, quickly assembling into two gigantic objects that spanned across the galaxy!

All of a sudden, two huge divine weapons pierced through the dazzling lightning. The mountain-sized black blades slashed at the center of the golden trident's side branches and collided with each other!

Clang!

The psionic shockwave exploded and swept across the artificial atmosphere of Planet Earth Ring, causing a chain reaction that instantly caused an explosion that swept across the entire planet!

Countless people hurriedly covered their ears with a pained expression. They felt as if someone was ringing a bell in their head, causing their heads to buzz. Many people also lost their balance like they were drunk and collapsed to the ground, unable to control their limbs.

In outer space, the two Mechanical Deities had already descended into the world. Their titan-like metal bodies were surrounded by thunderstorms, and they fought fiercely with their swords and halberds, creating piercing psionic arcs. They danced in the air and started fighting fiercely.

Every move of the Mechanical Deities contained terrifying power. Even though they were consciously moving away from Planet Earth Ring, the shockwaves they unconsciously caused countless landslides and tsunamis on the surface.

Their secondary dimensional army boxes continuously released their mechanical troops as if they were endless. They fought under the lead of their respective Apostle Weapons, splitting the space into countless small battlefields.

The battle artificial intelligence that was in charge of the overall situation kept arranging troops and competing with each other, trying to cut the enemy's formation and create a siege situation. From time to time, a mechanical soldier that was left behind would be blasted into pieces by the focus fire, but it would be restored under the guidance of Mechanical Force and re-enter the battlefield.

All of a sudden, the space around Planet Earth Ring was filled with psionic cannon tracks. These moving chains of light seemed to form an impenetrable net that covered the planet from afar.

From time to time, the metal streams that were melted by the high temperature would quickly cool down into irregularly shaped metal meteorites and fall to the ground, creating huge craters, or being blocked by the city's protective shield and shattering into dust.

This was not the first time that Han Xiao and Manison had fought each other, so they were familiar with each other's abilities. They went all out and released most of their Apostle Weapons.

Old Manison had forty to fifty Apostle Weapons under him. Their appearances were all strange and fancy, but the one thing they had in common was that they were all veteran mechanical life forms that had been around for many years. Their tinder energy was extremely strong, and their combat power was shocking.

Han Xiao had also taken out most of his assets. With Psionic Prime as the leader, there were more than 30 Apostle Weapons, more than half of what they had before!

The last time they fought, old Manison had dropped the Molding Grade Unique Talent (Billion Mecha Empire — Manison). Not only did it give many attribute bonuses, but it also increased a bunch of core Mechanic class skills by six levels, including [Apostle Life Creation]. This meant that he had six more Apostle Weapon slots!

A while ago, Han Xiao had created four new Universal Treasures and received feedback. He directly raised the Machinery Branch's God's Trait Transformation from the fifth level to the ninth level. Not only did he obtain a huge boost to his mechanical combat power, but he also obtained a few new Apostle Weapon slots.

With the combination of the two, Han Xiao's slots increased exponentially. While observing the situation of the Flickering War, he did not stay idle and enlightened more than ten new Apostle Weapons to strengthen the core team under him. Although there was still a gap between them and Manison, it was not as big as the previous time.

"With my current combat power, even if I don't use a Character Summon Card, I can still fight evenly with old Manison. I won't get beaten up like before."

Han Xiao controlled the Mechanical Deity to slash at the Mecha Empire while judging the difference in strength between him and the enemy.

The Machinery Branch's God's Trait Transformation's bonuses would gradually increase with each level. There was a threshold every five levels. Although he did not obtain the powerful bonuses of the tenth level, it was still four levels higher than before. The bonuses from the sixth to the ninth level were even greater than the first four levels, and it would greatly increase his combat strength.

The main difference in strength between him and Manison came partly from his foundation. He did not have as many godly equipment as the other party, and partly from his God's Trait Transformation level. Now, this gap had been greatly reduced.

Although ordinary Beyond Grade A Mechanics could obtain God's Trait Transformation Points by creating Universal Treasures, ordinary people did not have the interface and could not directly add points. The God's Trait Transformation points they obtained could be understood as a kind of experience, a kind of understanding. It required a long period of practice and understanding before they could convert it into actual God's Trait Transformation levels and complete the "point addition" step.

However, Han Xiao could directly add points, which was equivalent to skipping the conversion process that would take hundreds of years. This was why he could increase his strength so quickly in such a short period of time. Other Beyond Grade As could not replicate this at all.

Coupled with the huge bonuses of the (Billion Mecha Empire), the Titan Spine Center, Getta Hadoken, and other new Universal Treasures, Han Xiao judged that his strength in his normal state should be about the same as his strength after the last battle! At most, his basic attribute bonuses would not be comparable to the combination of (Polar Channel Flow — Blood Rage) and (Advanced Strengthened Life).

On the interface, the Mecha Empire's challenge mission had arrived as promised. It was not in vain for him to put down his integrity and choose to fight alone.

This was the third time he had taken advantage of the Mecha Empire.

"I'll use my experience while I'm at it. Every bit of strength counts."

Han Xiao glanced at the interface and used most of his accumulated experience to level up.

His level skyrocketed all the way to level 331 before stopping. There was not enough experience to continue leveling up.

Currently, the bonuses from leveling up were not much, but every Promotion and Life Rating Evolution would give him a huge boost. Therefore, although the bonuses from Awakening Points were higher, Han Xiao did not plan to spend his experience on this for the time being.

After all, it was already the end of Version 4.0. If he squandered his experience elsewhere, he might not be able to gather enough for the level 340 Promotion.

Boom! Boom!

Boom! Boom! The Mechanical Emperor's trident clashed with the Celestial Punishment Edge frequently, creating a shockwave mixed with psionic energy and golden lightning.

Manison felt the vibrations from every collision and was secretly shocked.

He clearly remembered that the last time they fought, the combat power of Black Star's Mechanical Deity in its normal state could not be compared to his at all. According to the previous experience, if Black Star did not use that strange explosive method, he should have been suppressed by him, but now, they were actually in a state of being evenly matched!

What made Manison's pupils constricted even more was that the number of Han Xiao's Apostle Weapons had almost doubled compared to the last time. This was not an increase from his explosive state but a manifestation of his basic mechanical ability!

"How did this guy train …"

Manison knew that Black Star was known for his rapid growth, but he still found it hard to understand.

Ever since he was young, he had always been a genius in the eyes of others. He was the pride of his race, and no one had ever been able to keep up with his progress. Everyone who tried to catch up with him would be left far behind after a while. He had never met a genius in the Mechanic class who could be compared to him.

However, when he met Black Star, Manison realized that he was inferior to someone else for the first time.

Things that he could not do, Black Star seemed to be able to do so easily. This feeling of disparity made him feel an emotion that he had never felt before. For the first time, he felt such a sour feeling.

Is this what people call jealousy?

"Why would I have such thoughts?"

Manison was shocked. He realized that Black Star had unknowingly shaken the strong confidence that he had built up over countless years.

His eyes narrowed, and he decisively suppressed this emotion, cut off all distracting thoughts, and returned to the state of Heart Like Still Water, fully focused on the battle.

At this time, Han Xiao suddenly swung his blade backward. The central spine of the Titan drove the torque of all the joints in the body. Like a bowstring that was constantly being pulled taut, a huge force surged from far away and poured into his arms.

Strange floating devices popped out from the surface of the body and floated beside the blade. They lit up with bright psionic light and connected with each other, forming a complicated pattern. They then released energy into the Celestial Punishment Edge at the same time.

A translucent light blue ball of light quickly formed on the blade, as if it was coated with a layer of bubbles.

Manison was about to block, but at this time, Black Star's thunderous roar suddenly sounded in the private channel.

"Air Quake — Getta Hadouken!"

The next moment, the blade drew a full moon arc and slashed down from above!

The power of this slash was far stronger than any of the previous attacks!

Manison was immediately alerted. He spun the trident and faced it head-on.

Boom!

It was as if two mountains had collided. The light blue ball of light on the blade was flung out and exploded on Manison's chest, sending him flying head-on.

The powerful shockwave reverberated through the body of the Mechanical Deity. Large cracks appeared on the surface of Manison's body in the blink of an eye, and pieces of outer armor were shattered.

Manison's energy flow stagnated for a moment, and he hurriedly adjusted it to absorb the mechanical soldiers around him and repair the damage to his body.

The power of this slash was not simple. He remembered that Black Star did not use this move last time. He did not know where he learned this move from recently, but it seemed to be a Universal Treasure level energy-gathering combat technique.

However, what annoyed him the most was not that he was knocked back but that he was not mentally prepared and was almost shocked by Black Star's roar.

If you want to fight, just fight. What the hell are you yelling for?

You even purposely sent me a voice message. Aren't you despicable?

The name of your move is so fancy. Do you think you're a Pugilist?

Manison felt the ball hurt a little.

"From the looks of the current situation, we won't be able to determine the winner anytime soon. The Dragon Emperor and the others can easily find the Soul Swapper. If he takes it away, it'll be meaningless for me to continue fighting with him. Looks like I'll have to use more trump cards."

Thinking of this, Manison's eyes sparkled.

…

"What terrifying power!"

At the edge of the battlefield, the captain of Planet Earth Ring carefully watched with the defense fleet. He kept exclaiming in shock.

Although he knew how strong a Beyond Grade A was, the impact of witnessing it with his own eyes was not something that any video could compare to.

"Luckily, before Black Star arrived, we didn't have a conflict with the Mecha Empire. Otherwise, with just the few of us, he would have wiped us out with a single slap."

The captain of Planet Earth Ring had a lingering fear. He felt that he was being very rational.

He turned around and looked at Ames and Hella, who were searching the planet. His eyes were filled with confusion.

"Black Star and the Mecha Empire seem to be looking for the same thing. What exactly are they looking for? Why are they making such a big fuss?"

At the same time, on the surface of Planet Earth Ring, countless people looked up at the battle in shock.

In outer space, the two Mechanical Deities were fighting with all their might. The light from the explosions illuminated the dark space time and time again. It could even be seen clearly on the surface.

"Brother, w-what do we do now?"

Both Jill and Warren were stunned by this earth-shattering battle, and an instinctive fear rose in their hearts.

Only then did the two of them realize how ridiculous it was to try and attack Black Star directly.

Such a terrifying being could turn us into ashes with just a breath, and we actually wanted to steal his body?

Thinking back now, we were simply courting death!

The two of them were the only ones who were qualified to use the Soul Swapper. Therefore, they had always believed that they were the chosen ones and had a strong, almost blind confidence in the Soul Swapper.

However, now that they experienced the shock of a peak Beyond Grade A battle at such a close distance, the two of them realized that they were completely ignorant people!

Actually, there was nothing wrong with this statement. The two of them had been imprisoned by the Modo Civilization for a long time, and the information they came into contact with was filtered.

"While their attention is distracted, let's quickly think of a way to leave. They really seem to be coming for us."

Seeing Black Star appear, Jill also felt that something was wrong. At this moment, there was only one thought in his mind.

Leave the Shattered Star Ring as soon as possible. I will not come out until I become a Beyond Grade A Super!

At the same time, Ames and Hella were flying in the atmosphere. Hella released her mental senses and scanned the people on the surface.

While looking for people, the two of them also looked at the battlefield in outer space.

"It seems like the two of them are evenly matched for the time being. We don't have to worry. Black Star will be fine for now."

Hila said in a low voice, her expression eager to try.

Seeing how intense the battle between Black Star and the Mecha Empire was, she was also itching to fight. Ever since she obtained the Underworld Dimension, she had not fought a Beyond Grade A other than Black Star with her full strength.

However, thinking of the thirty sparring sessions Han Xiao had promised, Hella reluctantly suppressed the surging battle intent in her heart.

"Let's quickly find him. The sooner we find the target, the sooner we can leave so that he doesn't have to take the risk to fight the Mecha Empire."

Ames shook her head.

Seeing this, she had to admit that in a battle of this level, she was indeed not of much help. Instead, she was a burden.

However, after fighting with Black Star back then, Ames had already accepted the fact that Black Star had surpassed her. Naturally, she would not feel depressed.

However, the next moment, their expressions suddenly changed, and they turned to look at the battlefield at the same time.

Just a moment ago, the two of them sensed that a few new Beyond Grade A energy sources suddenly flew out from the secondary dimensional army box of the Mecha Empire. The energy reaction was as eye-catching as a star!

This energy wave was not from an Apostle Weapon but a genuine Beyond Grade A Super!

"The Mecha Empire still has helpers?"

Hella stopped in midair with a serious expression.

"We have to go back and help! We can't watch the Army Commander get surrounded! "
